contract: Three page levels; last concrete product/topic page with only topic-specific article categories, each >=3 plausible later articles; variable categories never a fixed FAQ/Beratung/etc template; no maximum children and no search-volume-based exclusion.
notes: This is a PRELIMINARY qualitative role review based on naming/context and original parent path. It is not actual SEO/SERP or article-count validation.
A topic-like label may still be a valid thematic intent category when it is strictly scoped under the correct product page; do not convert automatically.
22 third-page draft parents cover 78 proposed terms; 3 further terms target preexisting page3 parents and are protected as such.
If a category would be a specific page3 topic, the old draft page3 grouping must be reexamined; never add fourth page depth.
Any item already synced in WordPress is protected by original ID, name, slug, parent, URL and downstream article bindings; NO automatic WP move/rename/delete.
DataForSEO is evidence for shorter search terms and search intent, not a low-volume filter.
